# Instruction attributes

All the attributes (except `category`) can be one of the following values: category, language, concepts, difficulty

## Category
The category of the instructions.

## Language
The programming language used to generate the instructions.

## Concepts
The concepts that should be covered by the generated instructions.

## Difficulty
The difficulty of the generated instructions, which can be one of the following values: very easy, easy, medium, hard, very hard.

# Development

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.8+
- PyTorch
- Transformers
- Python libraries: click, regex, fire, dataset-utils

## Dataset format

The dataset is formatted as a tab-separated text file (.tsv) with the following header:

```
category    language    concepts    difficulty    instruction
```

## Dataset download

The complete dataset can be downloaded from the repository's [releases](https://github.com/google-research-datasets/CodeXGLUE/releases).

## Instructions generation

### Interactive generation

To generate instructions interactively, run the following command:

```bash
python generate.py
```

### Batch generation

To generate instructions in batch mode, run the following command:

```bash
python batch_generate.py
```

## Dataset creation

To create the dataset from scratch, run the following command:

```bash
python create_dataset.py
```

The dataset will be created in `dataset/`.
